text:
Type: white and orange wall clock
Use: telling time on a wall; kitchen, living room, home office, children's room
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: molded matte face, orange metal hands
Colors: white fading to soft coral orange, bright orange hands
Shape: round frameless disc with raised embossed hour markers, ombre gradient from white at the top to orange at the bottom, slim hands, light visual weight
Feel: cheerful, soft, playful
Goes with: white walls, light wood, orange or peach accents; modern kitchens, playful or contemporary rooms

product.name: SPRALLIS
product.description: You can bring the feeling of warm sunlight into your room with this fabric-covered clock with vibrant orange print.
